title: First slice: core engine, CLI, spine conventions (raw, whitespace, html-text)
description: Pure-Rust core (canonicalize with source map, two-level diff, classification, redline.report.v1) plus CLI in the family shape: operator.v1, cmdrvl.doctor.v1, witness, spine-rules suite, README. Acceptance: SPEC section 6 invariants as tests, clippy/fmt/wasm gates green, CI green on GitHub.

Three independent review rounds (e9d7165, 141e09a verified by reviewer; third-round fixes in 4c65c78 re-verified by own tests only). title: Set HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN on cmdrvl/redline so releases update the tap
description: The release workflow's update-homebrew job pushes Formula/redline.rb to cmdrvl/homebrew-tap using the repo secret HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN. rvl has it; redline does not, and secret values cannot be copied between repos. Operator action: gh secret set HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN -R cmdrvl/redline.
close_reason: Not needed: the v0.1.0 update-homebrew job succeeded and pushed Formula/redline.rb to the tap (tap commit f912df5), so a token is already available to the repo.

title: docx mode (word/document.xml via zip + xml-text)
description: SPEC stage 1: optional docx feature reading word/document.xml. Depends on xml-text mode. Open point: spans index the decompressed XML, not the .docx bytes; decide how the report says so.

title: Finer formatting_only hunks
description: One formatting_only hunk covers a whole unchanged stretch from first to last differing byte. Also from review: the bounded Myers fallback has a granularity cliff on huge low-variety inputs (80k yes/no lines: 200 edits give 228 hunks, 1500 edits give 1 hunk; 320k lines with 200 edits already give 1). Verdict stays correct; hunks get coarse.

title: Markdown mode (offset-preserving, pulldown-cmark)
description: SPEC stage 2: --mode markdown using pulldown-cmark into_offset_iter so heading hierarchy and source byte ranges survive. Today the mode is refused with E_MODE_UNSUPPORTED. Needs the same invariant tests as html-text.

title: Verify inputs against a lock.v0 lockfile (--lock)
description: SPEC stage 1: --lock with blake3: and sha256: digests, E_LOCK_MISMATCH. Read lock's current lockfile shape before designing.

title: Region and section targeting; section labels on hunks
description: SPEC stage 3: section anchors (headings, Item N.NN), --region/--section, --old-span/--new-span, the section field on hunks, section_added/section_removed, E_REGION_INVALID. Zero-retention ruling needed first: a section label is document text, so default output must hash or omit it.

title: Optional text folding: Unicode normalization and typography
description:
Curly vs straight quotes (`“”` / `""`, `‘’` / `''`), en/em-dash vs hyphen variants (`–`/`—`/`-`), NFC vs NFD, non-breaking spaces, soft hyphens, and zero-width characters currently count as `text_modified` hunks when diffing re-exported HTML/SEC filings (producing dozens of spurious single-character quote-swap hunks per document).

## Scope
- Add an opt-in folding flag (e.g. `--fold-typography` or `--normalize-typography`) applied inside `src/canon/` while keeping the byte-offset source map into the original files exact.
- Folded-only differences (where raw bytes differ solely by folded quotes/dashes/NFC/soft-hyphens/zero-width chars) must be classified as `formatting_only` (preserving `UNCHANGED` outcome when no semantic hunks remain) rather than `text_modified`.
- Default behavior stays strict (no folding unless opted in); report envelope records the active folding setting deterministically.

## Acceptance
- Unit + CLI e2e tests covering curly-vs-straight quotes (`“foo”` vs `"foo"`, `Owner’s` vs `Owner's`), NFC vs NFD, soft hyphens, and zero-width spaces:
  - Strict default: emits `text_modified` hunks with exact original byte spans.
  - Opt-in folding enabled: emits zero semantic hunks (`formatting_only` only, `UNCHANGED` outcome) while preserving exact `old_span`/`new_span` offsets for any adjacent real edits.

title: Move detection: report relocated text as moved, not removed plus added
description: Seen on real 10-K year-over-year diffs (Covanta FY2012 vs FY2013): a sentence moved between paragraphs is reported as clause_removed in one place and clause_added in another. Detect equal or near-equal removed/added pairs and link them (a moved_from/moved_to reference or a class).

title: CLI and report cosmetics left from review
description: From the pre-release review, low severity, not fixed in v0.1.0: (1) --mode --version prints the version and exits 0; (2) a closed stdout exits 2 with 'Broken pipe', same code as a refusal; (3) an insertion at document start reports old_span [0,0], in front of a BOM or leading markup; (4) inserting into a renumbered lettered or numbered list can report text_modified or a span that straddles two items.

title: xml-text mode
description: SPEC stage 2: --mode xml-text. Reuse the html scanner where XML and HTML agree; differences: CDATA is text, only the five predefined entities plus numeric references, no implied head or raw-text elements, namespaces. Today refused with E_MODE_UNSUPPORTED.
